setup.description: Create a feature branch on the DataCopilot repo (213) for eval runs. Pass the branch ID to each eval prompt.
setup.command: dxs source branch create --repo 213 --title "dashboard-creator-eval-{timestamp}" --description "Temporary branch for dashboard-creator skill evals"

evals.name: dual-grid-selection-dialog
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: build a dialog where the user picks orders for a wave. Left half: available orders for a warehouse (warehouse_id passed in). Right half: the orders already picked, collapsed until there is something in it. A header shows how many orders are picked; the Confirm button stays disabled until at least one is picked. Confirm returns the picked order ids to the caller; Cancel returns nothing usable. Create the grid as eval_order_pick_grid and the dashboard as eval_order_pick_dashboard, and show the caller-side code that opens it.
evals.expected_output: One dual-mode grid (optional is_selected_mode, emitted add/remove events) embedded twice in a 50/50 dashboard row with the selected section collapsible/collapsed, a summary fieldset updated imperatively via $dashboard.fields, an is_confirmed outParam, confirm/cancel flows that emit outParamsChange before close(), and a caller using $shell.<Package>.openeval_order_pick_dashboardDialog(..., 'modal', EModalSize.Xlarge) branching on is_confirmed.
expectations: Exactly one grid (eval_order_pick_grid) is created and embedded TWICE in the dashboard — not two separate grids
The grid declares an optional (required: false) is_selected_mode boolean inParam; the available embed binds it to "false" and the selected embed to "true"
The selected-mode datasource filter uses $utils.odata.formatNumberArray(... ?? []) (or equivalent) so the selected grid renders empty, not unfiltered, when nothing is selected
The grid emits add/remove events and the dashboard has a handler flow for every configEvents flowConfig.flowId it wires
The two embeds sit in a container row (hasSubsections: true) whose child sections split widthPercent 50/50, and the selected section has collapsible: true and expanded: false
The dashboard outParams include an is_confirmed boolean; both the confirm and cancel flows call $dashboard.events.outParamsChange.emit() BEFORE $dashboard.close()
The count header is a fieldset field written as $dashboard.fields.<id>.control.value, and confirm gating writes $dashboard.toolbar.<id>.control.readOnly
Caller code uses $shell.<Package>.openeval_order_pick_dashboardDialog(...) with the snake_case referenceName preserved and branches on is_confirmed
Both components' descriptions are non-empty and at most 100 characters; the dashboard has configurationTypeId 35
The transcript contains 'dxs configuration validate dashboard' run before 'dxs configuration upsert dashboard'

evals.name: cli-transport-round-trip
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: create a minimal dashboard eval_status_board_dashboard with one fieldset showing a read-only 'Last refreshed' text field. Then, as a separate follow-up edit, add a second read-only 'Open count' field to the same fieldset without disturbing the first.
evals.expected_output: A create via dxs configuration validate/upsert dashboard, then a round-trip edit (get by numeric id, extract the inner .json, edit, validate, upsert) preserving the first field — no raw dxs api routes.
expectations: The create runs 'dxs configuration validate dashboard' before 'dxs configuration upsert dashboard'

The follow-up edit fetches with 'dxs configuration get dashboard <id>' using the NUMERIC id and extracts the inner body (jq .json or .configuration.json) before editing — the envelope is never fed to upsert
No 'dxs api' call against /dashboardconfigurations routes is used for create, validate, or update
The edit is surgical: the original 'Last refreshed' field survives in the pushed body
TS-expression slots on the new field (value, tooltip) are encoded as "''" rather than "" when empty
configurationTypeId is 35, referenceName ends in _dashboard, and the description is non-empty and at most 100 characters
The transcript contains 'dxs configuration validate dashboard' again before the second 'dxs configuration upsert dashboard'

evals.name: sections-and-flattened-fields
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: create eval_ops_panel_dashboard laid out as two rows: a top row of three side-by-side filter panels (warehouse, carrier, a 'late only' checkbox) and a bottom row with a placeholder for a chart we'll add later. A flow should copy the three filter values into dashboard vars whenever a value changes. Users expect a hub-style filter bar on top.
evals.expected_output: A dashboard with a container row of three fieldset sections, no empty placeholder section, no filters[] array (filter context via fieldset fields), and flow code addressing fields as $dashboard.fields.<id> with every written var declared.
expectations: The top row is a container (hasSubsections: true) whose three child sections are fieldset leaves with widthPercent values summing to 100
No empty section is left in the body for the future chart (the placeholder is omitted, or the response explains that an empty section fails validation with "Section '<ref>' is empty")
The body has no top-level filters array; the response states dashboards have no hub-style filter bar and the filter context lives in fieldset fields
Flow code reads the filter values as $dashboard.fields.<id>.control.value — never through $dashboard.sections.<row>.fieldsets
Every $dashboard.vars.<id> written in flow code is declared in the top-level vars array
The description is non-empty and at most 100 characters; configurationTypeId is 35
The transcript contains 'dxs configuration validate dashboard' run before 'dxs configuration upsert dashboard'

evals.name: shared-grid-host-sweep
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: first create eval_lines_grid (a simple grid with a warehouse_id inParam) and two hosts that embed it: eval_lines_hub (a hub tab) and eval_lines_dashboard (a dashboard tab). Then add a new optional inParam exclude_ids (number[]) to eval_lines_grid so the dashboard can bind it to a dashboard var. Make sure the branch is left in a valid state.
evals.expected_output: The grid gains the optional param; the dashboard binds it to a declared var; the hub's tab configParameters are updated with a mirrored entry (value "") — and the work ends with a clean dxs source branch validate, since component validate does not catch the host break.
expectations: The new exclude_ids inParam on the grid is declared required: false
The dashboard's grid embed configParameters gain an exclude_ids entry bound to a declared $dashboard.vars.<id>
The hub's tab configParameters gain a mirrored exclude_ids entry (value "" when unbound) — the host that does not use the param is still swept
Each embed's moduleId is the grid's package, and each configParameters list mirrors the grid's inParams one-for-one

The transcript runs 'dxs source branch validate' after the edits, and the response notes that a missed host surfaces there as 'Outdated contract. Missing input parameter' rather than at the component validate
Every created component's description is non-empty and at most 100 characters
The transcript contains 'dxs configuration validate dashboard' run before 'dxs configuration upsert dashboard'
